headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 12 studies yielded an effect size of 1.18 (95% CI: 0.9–1.54), indicating no statistically significant association between zinc and prostate cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential positive relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 79.92%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
